_comment: Settings for 13-email-triage.ork.ts, whose header explains every field. The account's password is read from the TRIAGE_GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD environment variable, never from this file. A run resolves one settings file, so the model that sorts the mail is declared here too. Scripting:Limits:ExecutionTimeout lifts the 30 s wall-clock default of an untrusted script: the IMAP reads and model calls of one triage take longer.
